name: LVM3
first: 印度的重型运载工作马 — 首次月球发射（月船3号，2023）
description: ISRO's three-stage launch vehicle (formerly GSLV Mk III): two solid S200 boosters, a liquid L110 core, and the indigenously-developed cryogenic CE-20 upper stage. Lifted Chandrayaan-2 (2019) and Chandrayaan-3 (2023) to lunar trajectories. Human-rated for the upcoming Gaganyaan crewed programme.
